description: Returns the current state of a Plot Speaks game in play, as text, without changing it. For trivia: the scores and the categories and values still on the board. For a survey or letter game: the scores, the open question or puzzle and what is revealed so far. For a timeline game: the line so far, lives and the open card. For Worms!: the tiles, stacks and open roll. Reads only; nothing is recorded. A play id that does not belong to that game returns an error, and a story that is not a game returns an error saying so.

play_id.description: The play id start_story returned for this game, e.g. 3f2b8c1e-9d4a-4e7b-a1c2-5b6d7e8f9a0b

slug.description: The game's slug or title, e.g. team-trivia

name: game_board
title: Trivia board
